note: Every published number, its status, the script that reproduces it, and the check that could make it wrong. PASS-1 = one run, provisional, never quoted as settled. PASS-2 = reproduced with a different parameterisation. withdrawn = it was published and then failed; kept so the record shows the retraction.

claims.claim: mode count = 8 pi V f^3 / 3 c^3 minus a surface term, fitted against exact enumeration
claims.falsifier: an independent mode count disagreeing by more than 1%

claims.claim: a rectangular space has 77-92% exact mode degeneracies
claims.falsifier: a space whose measured spacing statistic survives without degeneracy collapse

claims.claim: a 3x4x2.5 m room supports 3-4 of 4 streams at 20 dB (perfect-polarisation ceiling)
claims.falsifier: a measured 4x4 link giving fewer than 2 or more than 4 streams

claims.claim: with polarisation the count is 3-4 at 20 dB, so polarisation costs at most one stream
claims.falsifier: a cap sweep showing the count still moving at the full window

evidence: matches bisection to 0.00% over 12 V/Q combinations
claims.falsifier: a chamber whose measured uniformity onset disagrees with the formula

claims.claim: the 3 x fundamental rule of thumb is optimistic by 1.2-2.0x depending on Q
evidence: computed, never measured in a chamber
claims.falsifier: a measured chamber whose field becomes uniform at or below the rule of thumb

claims.claim: a two-state ambient link needs eta^2 m = 2[Q^-1(eps)]^2 samples
evidence: derived from Fisher information, not measured
claims.falsifier: a working link beating the bound at the same contrast and BER

claims.claim: 16-17 of 40 modes are usable at -60 dB with three probes, independent of Q, and the count saturates while the mode count grows 245x
evidence: Q 25/50/100 give exactly the same count in four spaces
claims.falsifier: a probe count or noise floor that moves the usable count by more than a factor of two

claims.claim: a 4x4 5 GHz link carries 3 of 4 streams at 20 dB, matching practice
claims.reason: the number was a property of the receive layout, not the room; superseded by the 3-4 range in scalar-streams

claims.claim: degree 2 instanton truncation fixes the h12>=5 sampler yield
claims.reason: confounded: maximum_degree=0 silently disables mirror instanton corrections, so the comparison was corrections off vs on

claims.claim: the ISD solve, not the sampler, is the h12>=5 wall
claims.reason: measured by a criterion whose two residual fields disagree by 75 orders of magnitude at the same point

claims.claim: a command reaches the operator only if local, ssh and mesh were tried and none worked
evidence: claiming a run with no attempt raises
a working mesh path + asked_operator raises
claims.falsifier: a session that asks the operator to run something while a path exists
